notes.content:
🔗👥 Meet Referral System! Invite your friend and get bonus!🎁

There is now a Referral System in the game. Get Friend Coin for each invited friend!

You can get your unique link here:
https://cats-game.online/ref

Current reward: 1x Friend Coin for each friend
Share your referral link with your friends and get bonuses!
*At this point, both you and your friend will receive a bonus.

HOW IT WORKS?
An account will be created if:
[olist]
 You own the Cats Game.
[/olist]
An account will be created and counted as a referral if:
[olist]
 The user owns the Cats Game.
 The user used a referral code during registration.
[/olist]
An account will be created, counted as a referral, and a reward will be given if:
[olist]
The user has a public Steam profile, allowing us to verify the Steam level.
The user has a Steam level of 5 or higher
[/olist]

At this stage, the system may be unstable.
